name: SVR Poker Quest WebXR

tablePolicy.championReset: All six seats restart at 10,000 on the next hand after one funded player remains.
tablePolicy.leaveRejoinReset: A deliberate LEAVE TABLE followed by PLAY GAME starts a fresh six-player table at 10,000 each.
tablePolicy.humanBustBehavior: The remaining funded players continue until a champion exists.
